cpu.isa_floor: x86-64 baseline, SSE2; no host tuning

limitations: Development model, protocol/policy and native single-connection IPC probe only; desktop and supported product qualification pending.
Exceptions and RTTI enabled; single-writer model and controller; native monotonic deadline checks do not qualify telemetry clock semantics.
Compiler/tool/archive fingerprints pin this installed environment; complete vendor archive and all header hashes are not available, so bit-for-bit reproduction is unproven.
Runtime floors are restricted to the observed host environment, not inferred backward compatibility.
Native IPC is exercised without elevation; cross-user/logon and desktop-session qualification require separate laboratories.
Initial IPC probe permits one live connection and at most two sequential clients; telemetry subscriptions and persistent commits are disabled.
SO_PEERPIDFD is required; peer POSIX-session identity is a launched-process boundary, not a desktop-login-session claim.
